headline: Huawei Produces Advanced SSDs with Proprietary Packaging, Circumventing US Semiconductor Restrictions
summary: Huawei's successful development of 122TB SSDs using its own packaging technology directly challenges the efficacy of US export controls, signaling a significant advance in China's domestic semiconductor capabilities. This development directly impacts global semiconductor supply chains, strengthens China's AI infrastructure autonomy, and escalates the ongoing geopolitical tech rivalry between the US and China.
